traducao: ......What is it?

original: ……一つ聞きたい。\nお前の、その……
traducao: ...Let me ask you something.\nThose... on your face...

original: そのメガネは、発売告知時点で即完売し、\n世界で１０セットしか生産されていないという\nレザレノ・カンパニーの限定品……か？
traducao: Are those glasses the Lezareno Company\nlimited edition, sold out immediately,\nwith only 10 sets made in the world?

original: ほう……これの価値がわかるか
traducao: Hoh... You know their value, then.

original: なるほど……その尻尾袋の品質も\n伊達ではないという事か
traducao: I see... The quality of your tail pouch\nisn't just for show either, then.

original: どうやら、話の通じる男の様だ
traducao: It seems you are a man of discernment.

original: ……ふっ、お前もな
traducao: ...Hmph. As are you.

original: リヒターさん、ここにいたんですね
traducao: There you are, Richter.

original: ……何の用だ
traducao: ...What do you want?

original: あの……また、パイを焼いたんです。\nですから、一緒に……
traducao: Um... I baked some pie again.\nSo if you'd like to join me...

original: 断る。\n馴れ合う理由も趣味もない
traducao: I refuse.\nI have no reason or desire to mingle.

original: ……そう……ですか
お前はなぜ、俺に構う
traducao: Why do you bother with me?

original: なぜ……？
traducao: Why...?

original: そんなの……理由なんてありません
traducao: Well... I don't really have a reason.

original: ふっ
traducao: Hmph.

original: 今のは、嫌味のつもりか？
traducao: Was that supposed to be sarcastic?

original: 嫌味……？
traducao: Sarcastic...?

original: ごめんなさい。\n理由がないって言ったのは、\nそんなつもりじゃ……
traducao: I'm sorry!\nWhen I said I had no reason,\nI didn't mean it like that...

original: お前は相手の顔色を伺わないな。\n決して媚びず、常にまっすぐだ
traducao: You don't care about others' reactions.\nNever fawning, always straightforward.

original: ……思った事を言っているだけです。\n不快な気持ちにさせてしまったなら……
traducao: ...I'm only saying what I think.\nIf I made you feel uncomfortable...

original: 誰が不快だと言った。\n他人に媚びへつらう事しか知らない\n豚よりはマシだ
traducao: Who said I was uncomfortable?\nYou're better than those pigs who only\nknow how to flatter others.

original: ……おい
traducao: ...Hey.

original: は、はい
traducao: Y-Yes?

original: お前の焼いたパイは、\nまだ残っているのか？
traducao: Is there any of that pie you baked\nstill left?

original: えっと……、\nたくさん焼きましたから\nまだ大丈夫だと思います
traducao: Um...\nI baked plenty of it,\nso there should be some left.

original: でも、無くなってしまっていても\nもう一度作りますから
traducao: Even if it's all gone, though,\nI can always bake more for you!

original: …………ふん。　そうか
traducao: ......Hmph. Very well.

original: ……一つ、お前に尋ねたい事がある
traducao: ...There's something I want to ask you.

original: ……何だ
traducao: ...What is it?

original: お前はどう思う。\nこの船の……
traducao: What do you think?\nAbout this ship's...

original: 料理当番制について、なのだが
traducao: cooking duty rotation, that is.

original: ……不満か？
traducao: ...Are you dissatisfied?

original: 不満というより疑問を感じるだけだ。\nなぜ、料理が出来ない人間にも役割を与える？
traducao: I'm not dissatisfied, merely puzzled.\nWhy give tasks to those who can't cook?

original: 誰しも得意、不得意はあるだろう
traducao: Everyone has their strengths and flaws.

original: 確かに、一見すれば非効率かもしれんな
traducao: Indeed, it may seem inefficient at first.

original: だが、物事の「始め」は概して危険なものだ。\nそして、始めなければ永遠に\n始まりは無い
traducao: Yet beginning anything carries risk.\nAnd if you never take the first step,\nthere can never be a beginning.

original: 始める事から始まる……か
traducao: A start must come from starting, huh...

original: 恐らく、アンジュは\n個人の未知の可能性を広げる場としても\n当番制は有益だと考えたのだろう
traducao: Perhaps Ange felt duty shifts were useful\nas an opportunity to broaden\nan individual's unknown potential.

original: なるほど。\nよくわかった
traducao: I see.\nI understand completely.

original: お前は、個人の可能性の助長の為に\n他人の作った不味い飯を\n平らげる覚悟があるという事がな
traducao: You're prepared to choke down bad food\ncooked by others, all to nurture\ntheir hidden potential.

original: ちなみに、今日の当番は俺だ。\n料理なぞろくにした事はないが、\n最善を尽くそう
traducao: By the way, today's cook is me.\nI've barely ever cooked before,\nbut I shall do my best.

original: ……食堂で待っているぞ
traducao: ...I'll be waiting in the dining hall.

original: 何か不自由な事はないか？　セルシウス。\n体に不調などがあれば言ってくれ
traducao: Is everything comfortable, Celsius?\nTell me if your body feels unwell.

original: 特にはないわ
traducao: Nothing in particular.

original: ここは風が気持ち良くて涼しいし。\nあえて言うなら、\n少し騒がしいのが気になるだけ
traducao: The wind is nice and cool here.\nIf I had to say anything,\nit's just a bit noisy.

original: ……そうか。\n問題がないならいい
traducao: ...I see.\nAs long as there's no problem.

original: そういうあなたは、\n少し疲れている様だけど
traducao: You, on the other hand,\nlook a little tired.

original: ……気疲れだ
traducao: ...It's mental fatigue.

original: この船の人間は、よく喋る。\nおまけに世話焼きで、うっとうしい
traducao: People on this ship talk too much.\nWhat's more, they're nosy and annoying.

original: わたしより、あなたの方が\n不自由さを感じている様ね、リヒター？
traducao: It seems you feel far less at ease\nthan I do, don't you, Richter?

original: …………そんな事はない
traducao: ......That is not true.

original: 不思議なものね。\nヒトというのがどういう生き物か\nわかったつもりでいたけど……
traducao: It's strange.\nI thought I understood\nwhat kind of creatures humans were...

original: いざ共に過ごしていると\n違ったものが見えてくる……か？
traducao: Living alongside them,\nyou begin to see them differently, huh?

original: あなたもなの、リヒター？
traducao: Is it the same for you, Richter?

original: ……まさか。\nヒトは欲深だ。　そして弱い。\n弱さ故に、より弱い存在を求める
traducao: ...Hardly.\nHumans are greedy. And weak.\nIn weakness, they seek the even weaker.

original: ……深く関わるだけ\n迷惑をこうむるのはご免だ
traducao: ...Getting deeply involved with them\nonly brings trouble I want no part of.

original: それは本心？\nそれとも建前かしら？
traducao: Is that how you truly feel?\nOr just a pretense?

original: どちらでもない。\n世の真理を言ったまでだ
traducao: Neither.\nI merely stated universal truth.

original: ……お前も知っているだろう？
traducao: ...You know that as well, don't you?

original: 確かに、\n犯した過ちは消せないでしょう
traducao: Certainly, mistakes made in the past\ncannot be erased.

original: けれどその過ちで、未来の全てを\n黒く塗りつぶすのも違うのではない？
traducao: Yet should that mistake stain\nthe entire future in black as well?

original: 精霊というのは存外、楽観主義だな。\nそれとも、単に気休めを言っているのか？
traducao: Spirits are surprisingly optimistic.\nOr are you merely offering empty comfort?

original: どちらでもないわ。\n世の真理を言ったまでよ
traducao: Neither.\nI merely stated universal truth.

original: なるほどね。\n確かに、この学説の矛盾を突くなら\nそういう解釈も有りかもしれないわ
traducao: I see.\nIf you're targeting that flaw,\nthat interpretation could actually work.

original: そういうお前の解釈は少々堅いな。\n思い入れが強いのは結構だが\nその分、視野を狭める事になるぞ
traducao: Your own view is rather rigid.\nPassion is fine, but it narrows\nyour field of vision.

original: 何よ。\nあんた喧嘩売ってるの？
traducao: Excuse me?\nAre you looking for a fight?!

original: にしても、ちょっと意外ね。\nリヒターが科学や歴史に\nここまで精通してたなんて
traducao: Even so, it's quite surprising.\nTo think Richter was so well-versed\nin science and history!

original: ……ただの暇つぶしだ。\nそれくらいしか、する事がなかった
traducao: ...Just a way to kill time.\nThere was little else for me to do.

original: はぁ？　\n暇つぶし？\nする事なかったって、何よそれ
traducao: Huh?!\nKilling time?\nWhat do you mean, 'nothing to do'?!

original: 引きこもりじゃあるまいし
traducao: It's not like you're a shut-in!

original: そうよねえ。\nこ〜んなに面白くて楽しいコト、\n暇つぶしにはもったいないわ∀
traducao: Indeed!\nSomething this interesting and fun\nis far too precious just to kill time!

original: したい研究を、\nしたいようにすれば良かった\nお前達とは違う
traducao: I'm not like you two,\nwho could study whatever you liked,\nin whatever way you pleased.

original: ……望んでこうなったわけではない！
traducao: ...I didn't choose to become like this!

original: ありゃりゃ。\n怒らせちゃったかしら？
traducao: Uh-oh.\nDid we make him angry?

original: 何なの、アレ。\n感じ悪っ
traducao: What's his problem?!\nTalk about bad attitude.

original: もしかしたら、特殊な生い立ちの\n持ち主だったのかもしれないわね〜
traducao: Perhaps he comes from rather\nunusual circumstances, hmm~

original: ……どうしたもんかしらねぇ
traducao: ...I wonder what we should do?

original: これ以上コハクに近寄ったら\nただじゃおかねえからな！
traducao: If you get any closer to Kohaku,\nyou're gonna regret it!

original: 何でだよ。\n別に何もしないよ
traducao: Why?!\nI'm not doing anything!

original: 当たり前だろーがッ！\n何かする気だったら、もっと\nただじゃおかねえ！！
traducao: Of course you ain't!\nIf you even thought about it,\nI'd beat you senseless!!

original: ええっ！\nそういう意味で\n言ったんじゃないのに……
traducao: What?!\nThat's not at all\nwhat I meant...

original: ……やれやれ、またですか。\n妹が大事なのもわかりますが\nあれは、少々考えものですねえ
traducao: ...Dear me, at it again?\nI understand treasuring a sister,\nbut that is a bit concerning.

original: ほう？\n家族とは一番無縁そうな人間から\nその様な言葉が出るとはな
traducao: Hoh?\nSurprising words from someone\nwho seems so distant from family.

original: まあ、人並み程度には\n兄弟愛なるものについて\n理解しているつもりですよ
traducao: Well, I believe I understand\nsibling affection reasonably well,\nmuch like any normal person.

original: 私にも、妹がいますから
traducao: After all, I have a younger sister too.

original: お前、長男だったのか！？
traducao: You're the oldest son?!

original: 驚くポイントがずれている気がしますが、\nその通りです。\n何か不都合でも？
traducao: Your surprise seems misplaced,\nbut that is correct.\nIs there any problem with that?

original: いや……
traducao: No...

original: お前の妹、か……。\n想像がつかないな……
traducao: A younger sister of yours, huh...\nI can hardly imagine it...

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

traducao: Laughter.\n
